verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets developers use natural language with an LLM client to connect to Adyen's platform and build payment solutions faster, which is direct evidence of agentic/natural-language operability for the broader Adyen platform (including POS APIs like Terminal API, refunds, etc.). However, this is framed as a developer-integration tool rather than natural-language control of live POS operations by an end user, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of it being used to operate point-of-sale flows conversationally. Missing for 10: evidence of end-user (non-developer) natural-language commands directly driving POS terminal actions, and independent corroboration of the MCP server's real-world use for POS tasks.
